# Sydney Automation Co.

> Sydney's premier Clipsal C-Bus and Signify Dynalite lighting control automation repair, programming, and fault diagnostics specialist. Founded and operated by George Skarmoutsos — former Clipsal National Technical Support specialist with 15+ years of factory-trained expertise. Same-day emergency service across Greater Sydney. Direct mobile: 0422 469 739.

Full technical documentation and diagnostic manual: https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/llms-full.txt

## Who We Are

Sydney Automation Co. is founded and operated by George Skarmoutsos, an Ex-Clipsal National Technical Support specialist with 15+ years of hands-on experience in lighting control automation. George holds the highest tier manufacturer accreditations:
- **Schneider Electric / Clipsal Accredited C-Bus Programmer** — Commissioning, network diagnostics, and fault rectification using C-Bus Toolkit.
- **Signify / Philips Dynalite Accredited System Designer** — Programming and architecture design using Dynalite System Builder.
- **DALI & DALI-2 Certified Specialist** — Bus diagnostics, commissioning, and AFSS annual fire safety emergency lighting testing.
- **RAPIX Emergency Lighting** — Commercial compliance testing and integration.

Unlike general electricians who lack proprietary diagnostic software, or luxury smart home integrators who insist on entire $30,000–$50,000 rewiring overhauls, Sydney Automation Co. resolves over 90% of faults on-site by repairing or replacing individual DIN-rail modules without rewiring. Every service includes a 100% database backup file handover to the property owner.

## Primary Services

- **C-Bus Fault Finding & Same-Day Repairs** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/cbus-repair-sydney): On-site diagnosis of network burden failure, uncommunicative keypads, stuck relays, burnt power supplies, and voltage drop (15–36V DC bus line checks).
- **C-Bus Toolkit Programming & Scene Restoration** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/c-bus-programmer-sydney): Scene adjustments, daylight harvesting, schedule corrections, logic scripting, and project database recovery from unlabelled networks.
- **C-Bus Legacy Hardware Upgrades** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/cbus-upgrade-sydney): Upgrading obsolete 5000-series relays, dimmers, and touchscreens to SpaceLogic C-Bus modules (5500NAC2, 5500SHAC) with Apple HomeKit and mobile smartphone app control.
- **Dynalite Fault Diagnostics & Controller Repair** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/dynalite-repair-sydney): RS-485 DyNet trunk testing, address clashes, baud rate mismatch resolution, and controller replacement (DDBC1200, DDMC802).
- **Dynalite System Builder Programming** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/dynalite-programmer-sydney): Commercial and high-end residential lighting control programming, preset scene adjustments, and BMS gateway integration.
- **DALI & DALI-2 Emergency Lighting Compliance** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/afss-emergency-lighting-services): 90-minute discharge testing, computerized logging, and Annual Fire Safety Statement (AFSS) certification for commercial buildings and strata facilities.
- **Car Park Lighting Automation & Maintenance** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/carpark-lighting-upgrades-sydney): DALI-2, microwave sensor, and C-Bus automated lighting maintenance for multi-level commercial and shopping centre car parks.
- **Electrician Trade Partner Support** (https://sydneyautomationco.com.au/electricians): White-label sub-contracting and technical backup for licensed electricians encountering complex C-Bus or Dynalite communication failures.

## Hardware & Models Stocked in Service Vans

Sydney Automation Co. carries replacement modules directly in mobile service vans for immediate same-day swap-out:
- **C-Bus Relays & Dimmers:** L5512RVF, 5504RVF, 5508RVF, 5504D2A, 5508D1A, 5504TD.
- **C-Bus Controllers & Network Interfaces:** 5500NAC2 (SpaceLogic Network Automation Controller), 5500SHAC (SpaceLogic Smart Home Controller), 5500CN2, 5500PC, 5500PS (Power Supply Unit).
- **C-Bus Keypads & Wall Switches:** Saturn Series, Neo Series, eDLT, DLT, Reflection, and Standard 30-Series.
- **Dynalite Controllers & Interfaces:** DDBC1200, DDMC802, DMRC210, DDNG485, DDNG232, Antumbra button and display keypads, DUS360 sensors.

## Transparent Pricing Structure

- **Residential On-Site Diagnostic Assessment:** $280 fixed assessment (includes comprehensive multimeter line testing, burden verification, C-Bus Toolkit or Dynalite System Builder software bus scan, and written fault report).
- **Hourly Service & Programming Rate:** $150/hr for subsequent repairs and custom programming.
- **Commercial & Strata Assessment:** $450 fixed diagnostic call-out.
- **Component Replacement:** Quoted transparently before installation based on exact manufacturer module requirements.
